visual_forensic_findings: The image reveals extensive unauthorized gray-toned concrete plinths and linear structural layouts directly encroaching upon the Gomti River's natural floodplain and sandbar areas. Visible boundary wall construction and significant soil disturbance indicate organized, permanent settlement encroachment within the protected ecological corridor.
environmental_threat: Destruction of the Gomti flood retention buffer significantly increases the risk of urban flash flooding in Lucknow and causes permanent degradation of local groundwater recharge zones.
statutory_violation: Violation of the NGT Gomti Buffer Order O.A. 6/2012 and Section 27 of the UP Urban Planning & Development Act 1973.
legal_demolition_notice: Notice is hereby issued to the occupants of Site LKO-ENC-20261020-467 regarding illegal construction within the protected Gomti River floodplain. You are commanded to cease all activities immediately and vacate the encroached area of 31,800 m². Failure to comply within 48 hours will result in immediate demolition of all structures by the Lucknow Development Authority at your sole cost and risk.
tactical_radio_script: All units, urgent dispatch to Site LKO-ENC-20261020-467. Illegal concrete encroachment detected in Gomti buffer zone. Secure perimeter immediately. Prepare for heavy machinery deployment. Over.
